$comment: PLAN-0628 M3 cross-language contract: the skills listing CP renders and the block the Agent puts into ${xh.skill_catalog} must agree byte-for-byte. CP's SkillCatalogSourceService.view(Listing) produces `componentView` from `listing`; the Agent's context/skill_catalog.render_from_component_sources turns that same `componentView` into `agent.expectedContent`. Both suites read THIS file: packages/control-plane/src/test/java/com/cc01cc/p/xihe/cp/skill/SkillCatalogRenderFixtureTest.java and packages/agent/tests/unit/test_skill_catalog_render_contract.py. Listing items carry only the fields the renderers read (skillId, qualifiedName, name, description, tier); version/contentHash/oversize never reach a rendered line. Changing a case means changing the contract.
rule: CP renders one line per item: display + ' — ' + description, where display = name unless a name collision forces the qualifiedName; CP never truncates a line, never adds framing and never adds the truncation sentence (D28-41: reserved budget belongs to the final renderer). The Agent prepends `header`, keeps a prefix of CP's lines within the skills cap, and appends `truncationNote` whenever the listing is incomplete - either because its own budget cut it or because CP already reported truncated=true.
header: Available skills (name — description); load full text by name when relevant:
truncationNote: （上面只是部分可用 skill；需要其他 skill 时请按名称直接尝试，不要据此断言它不存在。）

items.name: writing-with-a-name-near-the-validator-ceiling-for-budget
items.description: Rewrite a long document while preserving every heading, list marker, table alignment, and inline code span, then report which sections changed and why, and keep a short diff-friendly summary for the reviewer who asked for the rewrite in the first place. Keep the original voice unless the caller explicitly asks for a tone change, quote the sentence that forced each structural edit, and never renumber headings that other documents link to; when a section cannot be rewritten without losing meaning, leave it untouched and explain the blocker instead of inventing content
